heading: Protection, use and management of renewable resources on non-Federal lands; utilization of Assessment, surveys and Program by Secretary to assist States, etc.
lead: The Secretary may utilize the Assessment, resource surveys, and Program prepared pursuant to this subchapter to assist States and other organizations in proposing the planning for the protection, use, and management of renewable resources on non-Federal land.

notes.text: Amendments2018—Pub. L. 115–141 substituted “Secretary” for “Secretary of Agriculture”.

ancestors.heading: FOREST AND RANGELAND RENEWABLE RESOURCES PLANNING
